result.reason: The clause appropriately extends the licence to Affiliates and contractors, but it does not provide perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences, permits subscription rights to end upon any contractual termination or expiration rather than only for uncured material breach, and omits transferability to successors. It also unnecessarily deletes “solely,” modestly broadening the permitted-use restriction. The retained Services nexus and software-use restrictions otherwise preserve the original commercial intent.
